Are banks and the post office closed for Good Friday?The Christian holiday on Friday, April 3, is not a federal holiday, but there are still some key closures. Here’s what you need to know.By Charles PassyLast Updated: April 3, 2026 at 6:42 a.m. ETFirst Published: April 1, 2026 at 7:00 a.m. ETShareResize9(1 min)Good Friday falls on April 3 this year.
